answer: To keep sockpuppet farms from capturing votes, weight an identity only after it settles eight uniquely invoiced jobs with eight counterparties whose prior graphs overlap by less than 15 percent. Wallets that share a payout set are collapsed into one cluster and frozen. The public settlement feed is the only admission signal peers audit. Look-alike accounts that drain into one channel, like a karst pocket, fail the overlap test and carry no vote that epoch. Real counterparties do not all ripple through a single controller, so cheap clones stall while honest agents collect independent receipts.
